messages:
Devon H: quick sync — need to lock TTFT / tok/s / p95 definitions before we ship the new runtime dashboard. Two asks: 1) definitive metric formulas (how TTFT = first-token time measured, sampling rules), 2) owners for per-model panels + who will run the bench matrix (fp16 vs int8, 2k/8k seq).
Maria L: +1. For TTFT we should use server-side first-byte after receive (exclude client network). sample: use request_start -> first_token_emitted. bucket by model+hw+seq. p95 calculated across successful responses only.
Aj Patel: I can own the dashboard panels for gpt-like models. will add model tags and a breakdown by quant mode. ping me on PR.
Samir R: I can run the bench matrix on dedicated cluster. request: list of model variants + target seq lengths. prefer to run baseline then quant runs back-to-back to reduce variance.
Devon H: thanks. shortlist: "redwood-v1" (fp16, int8), "rw-7b" (fp16, int8), "rw-3b-8k"(fp16). seqs: 2k, 8k. sampling window: 24h of production-like traces or synthetic traces?
Maria L: 24h prod-like sample + synthetic stress runs. For p95 make sure to filter out warmup requests and retries. SQL-ish for p95:```sqlSELECT model, quant_mode, percentile_disc(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY first_token_ms) AS p95 FROM requests WHERE success=true AND request_ts >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY model, quant_mode;```
Samir R: ok I'll schedule bench runs tonight. will tag run ids in this thread. expected run time ~3h per matrix cell.
Aj Patel: small ask for panel: add tok/s as tokens_emitted / request_duration_seconds, and separate chart for prefix-cache hits vs misses.
Devon H: agree. Also need alerting thresholds: propose p95 alert if increases >20% above baseline for a rolling 12h window. thoughts?
Maria L: 20% seems reasonable as a starting point. Add an automatic rollback policy for Dedicated customers? maybe just notify first.
Aj Patel: recommend page on >50% regression. for initial rollout we'll only page on >50%. keep 20% as warn in console.
Samir R: bench-bot will post run stats when done. bench matrix queued as run: bm-1932. I'll attach raw logs.
bench-bot: bench bm-1932 started on cluster-dedicated-3. config: models=[redwood-v1,rw-7b], quant=[fp16,int8], seq=[2k,8k].
ci-bot: dashboard PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/dashboard/pulls/482 — @Aj Patel assigned for review.
Devon H: perfect. next steps: Samir runs benchmarks (tag results), Aj implements panels + PR, Maria drafts metric doc for metrics repo. I'll consolidate owners and update roadmap. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Maria L: I'll put the metric doc draft in /docs/metrics/ttft-metric.md and link it here when ready.
Samir R: bench-bot posted run bm-1932-complete: mean_tok_s=1200 tok/s, p95_first_token_ms: fp16=42ms int8=57ms (8k). uploading logs to s3://redwood-bench/bm-1932/.
Devon H: great — please paste the run link and a short summary in the PR. we'll use these numbers as baseline for alerts.
Aj Patel: will do. starting panel work now, expect PR in ~2 days.
